Subject: Pricing sketch & layered response credit option

Michelle / team — following Alex's note, I pulled together a pragmatic packaging option that many health-tech customers choose when they want predictable economics without overpaying for a full 24/7 SRE seat. Key points:

1) Layered response credits (recommended for pilot -> production ramp)
   - Base SLA (Enhanced 99.95) included in hosting. Credits issued per incident minute after SLA breach.
   - Add-on "P1 Escalation Credits" bucket: pre-bought blocks (e.g., 10, 25, 50 credits) that cover guaranteed engineering engagement windows beyond the standard acknowledgment SLA. Credits are consumed on a per-page basis when escalation to engineering is requested.

2) On-call retainer + overage pricing
   - Monthly retainer (Tier A / Tier B) provides 24/7 paging, a named escalation engineer, and two guaranteed on-site (remote) war-room hours per quarter for postmortems.
   - If the retainer bucket is exhausted, additional engagement billed at a discounted hourly rate.

3) Discounting structure (anchor for negotiation)
   - Month-to-month: list price
   - 12-month commit: 12% discount on hosting + 6% discount on retainer
   - 24-month commit: 18% discount on hosting + 10% on retainer
   - Additional 3% strategic partner discount available for customers with >$500k ARR commit in year one (requires Legal approval).

4) True-up and cap
   - We permit a mid-year true-up and offer a cap on monthly overage charges to protect against runaway costs during pilot spikes. Cap terms are negotiable (example: cap at 150% of committed monthly spend).

I've populated the attached quote workbook with the three configurations: Pilot (low), Scale (mid), and Production (high). If you prefer, we can present this as two discrete line items (hosting + retainer) or as a single bundled SKU with pre-bought credits.

Notes: the P1 30-min response guarantee is part of our Premium tier; Enhanced provides a 1-hr P1 acknowledgement with 30-min engineering engage target when credits are consumed. If you need a hard 30-min engineering engagement SLA for all incidents, that maps to Premium and has a higher retainer.

Happy to jump on a call Friday to walk through numbers.

-Rishi
